messages:
Maya: Heads-up — ACME tenant hit a big spike during their sandbox stress run. Renewal in ~30d, so we should give them a customer-facing 'tenant hydration' checklist that is prescriptive and low-friction. Need quick wins for caching + streaming fallback.
Arjun: Agreed. I'll draft a 1-page checklist. want it to be safe to follow by PMs/engineers on their side.
Jamie: High-level: 1) short prefill run to warm KV + embedding cache, 2) client-side jitter + exponential backoff, 3) enable streaming with small chunk sizes as fallback, 4) ramp traffic to warm pools.
Sam: Add a telemetry section: what to watch (95p latency, token rate, error % by route) and exact alert thresholds. Also add a rollback step.
Maya: Can we include a tiny policy snippet customers can drop in? e.g., recommended prefill payload + suggested cache TTLs. Keep it copy-paste.
Arjun: Draft payload below — meant for the hosted API prefill endpoint. 👍

```
POST /v1/prefill
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "model": "rwd-13b-opt",
  "prefill_batches": 4,
  "batch_size": 8,
  "concurrency": 2,
  "input_samples": ["small_prompt_1", "small_prompt_2"],
  "warm_kv": true
}
```
Jamie: Suggested cache TTLs: embeddings cache = 24h for onboarding, prefix/KV cache = 30m-2h depending on prompt churn. Document notes: if production churn > 30% per hour, prefer shorter TTL + more frequent small prefill cycles.
Sam: Client-side jitter example to avoid thundering herd:
```
let delay = base * Math.pow(2, attempts) + Math.random() * jitter
```
Include guidance: max backoff 60s, cap retries to 5 for interactive flows.
EngOncall: @Arjun we'll need to wire an on-call playbook: set alerts for token_rate > 2000/min, 95p latency > 300ms, error_rate > 2% — auto page if sustained for 2 mins. Also add an automated fallback to smaller model variants and to streaming-only mode.
Maya: For the customer-facing doc, let's structure as: TL;DR, Preflight checklist (run prefill, confirm TTLs, enable streaming), During surge (apply jitter, activate warm pool), Post-surge (reduce prefill frequency, collect feedback).
CS-Bot: Prefill job queued for acme-123 — job_id=pf_20260321122 ETA ~12m.
Arjun: I'll push a one-pager in the shared drive and paste link here when done. Aim to hand this to AM + SE tomorrow.
Jamie: Quick QA note — include a short troubleshooting table: e.g., symptom: high tail latency + low token_rate => likely cold KV; remedy: run immediate prefill 1-2 batches and check pool utilization.
Maya: Perfect. @Sam can you own the renewal-risk blurb (how this reduces perceived platform risk)? @Sam: yep.
Sam: Will draft a 3-sentence blurb and attach to the checklist.
Maya: Thanks all. Arjun — ping me when the doc link is ready and we'll send to AMs. :thumbsup:
